scope: The committee elected on 1979-10-09, changes during that term, and the 1982-10-12 replacement election as a closing boundary; not the preceding 1978/79 session or the new 1982-1985 term

rule_references.use: Constitutive election declarations; term elections continue until a new election; leaving parliament or becoming a minister ends eligibility; resignation requires parliamentary consent

rule_references.provisions: RO 4:2, SFS 1978:193; transition retains annual elections in 1978/79
rule_references.use: The October 1979 election is for the parliamentary term, not just the annual session
Leave-related substitutes are separately elected; ordinary appointees do not lose committee membership merely by taking leave
RO 7:3, 7:6 and 7:10-11 were not amended during the pilot; distinguish the 1975 changes to 7:8/12 and the 1978 change to 4:2 from later law
